name: CoIN-Bench
description:
Collaborative Instance Object Navigation - CoIN-Bench dataset (v1) - ICCV 25
	



We introduce Collaborative Instance object Navigation (CoIN), a new task setting where the agent actively resolve uncertainties about the target instance during navigation in
natural, template-free, open-ended dialogues with human.
To download the dataset, just run the following command:
from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
snapshot_download(repo_id="ftaioli/CoIN-Bench", repo_type="dataset"… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ftaioli/CoIN-Bench.
reputation: A new, specialized benchmark for collaborative, dialogue-driven embodied navigation that is gaining interest in the embodied-AI and HRI communities but is not yet widely adopted.
